blocks.html: Complete 2026 guide for travelling from Islamabad to Nathia Gali. Best routes, driving distance, time, tips for each season, what to pack, and what to expect on arrival.

The drive from Islamabad to Nathia Gali is one of the most rewarding road journeys in Pakistan. The distance is short, the route rises through some of the country's most dramatic hill scenery, and the arrival at 7,906 feet above sea level immediately delivers the temperature drop, pine forest air, and visual shift that makes Nathia Gali the most popular mountain escape in the country for Islamabad and Rawalpindi residents. At approximately 80 to 90 kilometres by the most direct route, Nathia Gali is close enough for a weekend trip and rewarding enough for a week.

This guide covers everything you need before the journey: which route to take based on your start point and travel conditions, how long the drive actually takes in different traffic scenarios, what to prepare for winter versus summer visits, where to stop along the way, and what to know about Nathia Gali itself when you arrive. It is written for people making the trip in 2026, with current road conditions and seasonal considerations in mind.
Islamabad to Nathia Gali: Distance and Basic Route Information

The straightforward answer on distance is that Islamabad to Nathia Gali covers approximately 80 to 90 kilometres by the most commonly used route through Murree. Driving time under normal traffic and weather conditions runs between 1 hour 45 minutes and 2 hours 30 minutes. Peak season weekends and winter snowfall conditions can push this to 3 hours or more.

blocks.html: The Murree route is the most direct and most scenic. It begins on the Islamabad-Murree Expressway (E-75), climbs to Murree at approximately 2,168 metres elevation, then continues along the Murree-Nathia Gali road through Bhurban and Changla Gali for a further 38.8 kilometres to Nathia Gali. This final stretch through the Galyat range is the most visually rewarding portion of any Islamabad to Nathia Gali journey, winding through dense pine and cedar forests with valley views at multiple points.
The Murree Route Step by Step

Start from Islamabad's Faizabad interchange or Murree Road heading northeast. The Islamabad-Murree Expressway takes you directly toward Murree with clear signage throughout. Petrol stations are readily available up to Murree, where you should fill up before continuing, as options diminish significantly on the Nathia Gali side. The expressway section to Murree covers about 36 kilometres and takes 45 to 60 minutes.

From Murree's main bazaar, follow the road toward Bhurban and Changla Gali. This section narrows and gains more curve intensity as you move through the Galyat hill stations. Dhamtor, Khanspur, and Changla Gali all appear as waypoints on this stretch. Nathia Gali is the last significant hill station before the road continues toward Abbottabad. The PAF airbase boundary on the right side of the road signals you are entering the immediate Nathia Gali area.

The Abbottabad Alternative Route

The Abbottabad to Nathia Gali route is the preferred alternative when the Murree expressway is heavily congested, which happens on summer peak weekends when the Islamabad to Murree road can see traffic queues extending well past Rawalpindi. Take the Hazara Motorway north from Islamabad toward Havelian and Abbottabad. From Abbottabad city, Nathia Gali is 35 kilometres east on the Abbottabad-Nathia Gali road, a 45 to 60-minute drive through progressively ascending terrain.

This route is slightly longer in total distance but often faster on summer peak weekends. It is also the better choice for visitors coming from Rawalpindi's southern or western areas who would otherwise need to cross the city to reach the Murree expressway. The Abbottabad section of this route passes through Ayub Medical Complex and the city centre before climbing toward Nathia Gali, so factor in some city driving time.
Travel Time: What to Realistically Expect

The standard 2 to 2.5-hour estimate assumes you leave Islamabad before 9 AM or after 4 PM on a weekday, or travel Sunday through Thursday. The peak weekend scenario is different. Friday and Saturday departures from Islamabad toward Murree during summer months (June to August) can see the journey extend to 3.5 to 5 hours when traffic queues form on the Murree Expressway. Departing before 7 AM or after 8 PM on summer weekends largely avoids this congestion.

Winter snowfall transforms the timing calculation entirely. When snowfall has affected the Galyat roads, the Murree to Nathia Gali section can take twice the normal time even with chains fitted. Check NHPA road status updates and the PTDC social channels before departing in winter. TheNathia Gali weather and seasons guidecovers winter road conditions and what to check before a winter trip.
What to Pack for the Journey
Summer and Monsoon Season (June to September)

Summer days in Nathia Gali remain comfortable at 20 to 25 degrees Celsius, but evenings drop significantly. Pack layered clothing even for a midsummer visit. Light rain gear is essential from July to September when afternoon and evening monsoon showers arrive reliably. The Islamabad to Nathia Gali drive through the Galyat region is particularly beautiful during and after rain when mist settles across the pine ridges, but road surfaces become slippery at higher elevations, so cautious speed adjustment is important.
Autumn and Spring (October to November, March to May)

These shoulder months offer excellent driving conditions on the Islamabad to Nathia Gali route. Autumn brings clear air and golden foliage. Spring brings wildflower blooms and trail openings after winter. Pack layers as temperatures remain variable, particularly at the higher Galyat elevations above Murree.
Winter (December to February)

A winter visit to Nathia Gali is a completely different experience from summer, and the Islamabad to Nathia Gali drive reflects this. Snow chains are required at times for the Galyat road section. Even without chains, winter tyres or heavy-tread tyres significantly improve safety on the mountain section. Carry extra warm clothing, emergency food and water, a portable phone charger, and a physical map in case GPS connectivity drops in heavier snowfall. Check that your vehicle's heating system is fully functional before departing.

Where to Stop Between Islamabad and Nathia Gali
The Murree route offers several worthwhile stops depending on your timeline and appetite.

items: Murree Bazaar and Cahen's Point: Murree's main bazaar makes a natural midway stop for chai, snacks, and the classic Murree tourist market experience. Kashmir Point above Murree offers a viewpoint toward Kashmir Valley worth a brief stop if you are not under time pressure.

Bhurban: The Pearl Continental Bhurban sits on a ridge above the Galyat road with a golf course and mountain views. It functions as a destination in its own right and as a landmark on the Islamabad to Nathia Gali drive.
Changla Gali: A small hill station with a handful of local eateries and shops. A popular tea stop before the final stretch to Nathia Gali.
Khanspur: Quieter than Murree or Nathia Gali with dense pine forests. Worth a stop if you want a short forest walk before reaching your destination.

blocks.html: Nathia Gali Arrival: What to Know When You Get There

Nathia Gali's main bazaar is small and genuinely walkable. Most essential services, including small grocery shops, a pharmacy, ATMs (though carry cash from Islamabad to be safe), and local restaurants, are within 10 minutes on foot from the main road. The bazaar shuts relatively early by city standards, typically by 9 or 10 PM, and many restaurants serve last orders around 9 PM.

Parking in Nathia Gali's main area is limited during peak seasons. Properties with dedicated parking, includingSerene Heights, which provides parking with every unit, save guests from the frustration of arriving after a mountain drive and searching for a spot. This is a detail worth confirming explicitly when booking any accommodation in Nathia Gali.

Mobile network coverage from Zong and Jazz is generally reasonable throughout the Galyat region, though it varies by precise location. Telenor coverage can be patchy on some road sections. If GPS is essential for your navigation, download offline maps before departing Islamabad, particularly if you are planning to reach properties away from the main Nathia Gali bazaar.
Day Trip vs Overnight Stay: Which Makes More Sense?

Nathia Gali is close enough to Islamabad for a day trip in terms of distance, but the experience of a day trip is fundamentally different from a stay. A day trip typically means arriving around midday, spending three to four hours exploring, having a meal, and beginning the return drive by 5 PM to avoid darkness on the mountain road. The coolest and most atmospheric morning hours are spent entirely on the road.

A two- or three-night stay shifts the entire experience. You wake to mountain mornings with no commute. You can do the Miranjani or Mushkpuri treks at the right pace. You have evenings for walking the bazaar. blocks.html: Frequently Asked Questions

blocks.q: How far is Islamabad from Nathia Gali?
a: Islamabad to Nathia Gali is approximately 80 to 90 kilometres by the Murree route, or 105 to 115 kilometres via Abbottabad. The Murree route is the most commonly used and most scenic. Driving time is 2 to 2.5 hours under normal conditions and can extend to 3 to 5 hours during peak weekend summer traffic.

blocks.q: Is the Islamabad to Nathia Gali road safe in winter?
a: The road is driveable in winter with appropriate preparation. Snow chains are advisable and sometimes mandatory on the Galyat section after significant snowfall. Checking road status before departure through NHPA announcements is essential. The Murree to Nathia Gali section is more challenging in heavy snow than the expressway portion. Travel in daylight hours during winter and avoid the road immediately after heavy snowfall until it has been cleared.

blocks.q: What is the best time to leave Islamabad to avoid traffic?
a: On summer weekends, departing before 7 AM avoids the worst congestion on the Murree Expressway. A Thursday evening departure is a popular alternative for families who want to arrive Friday morning. During weekdays and in shoulder seasons, any departure time between 8 AM and 2 PM is generally traffic-free.
